label: H.R. 6967
title: Public Company Advisory Committee Act of 2026

items.snippet: This bill establishes the Public Company Advisory Committee within the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.amount_note: Amounts are the income or expenses reported on the whole LD-2 filing, not money spent on this bill.

estimates.title: H.R. 6967, Public Company Advisory Committee Act of 2026
estimates.description: As ordered reported by the House Committee on Financial Services on January 22, 2026

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

L000491.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
L000491.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
